overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong academic and research-focused presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. Content primarily centers around published research, grant awards, tool releases (CooRnet), hiring announcements, and conference presentations, driving consistently high engagement among specialized academic and data science audiences.

contentThemes.description: Research findings, tools like CooRnet, and methodological discussions on tracking online manipulation.
Job openings for postdoctoral researchers and research opportunities for PhD students.
Announcements of awarded research grants, newly published papers, and upcoming conference talks.

recommendations: Increase visual media usage (e.g., charts, publication figures, software screenshots) to boost visibility and engagement across platforms.
Cross-promote major milestones (like grant awards or paper releases) across all three platforms simultaneously rather than limiting specific types of announcements to single networks.
Encourage audience interaction by posing open discussion questions alongside research updates to convert likes into comments.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest average engagement rate (6.14%) with strong repost ratios, showing high viral potential for research papers and academic calls.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves as an effective niche hub for open-source tools (CooRnet) and academic discussions, maintaining steady interaction relative to audience size.
platformInsights.linkedin: Drives the highest absolute engagement in terms of raw likes and comments, proving ideal for career announcements, team hiring, and grant awards.
